Google Fonts serves its font files from `fonts.gstatic.com`. A `<link>` to that host is there to open the connection early, so the font download does not wait for DNS and TLS. Without `rel="preconnect"`, the browser does not do that.

The rule looks at `<link>` elements with an `href` that starts with `https://fonts.gstatic.com`.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```jsx
const hint = <link href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />;
```

{/* bad */}
```jsx
const hint = <link rel="preload" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const hint = <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" />;
```
